name: spec-cycle-lens
description: Read-only lens over a spec-cycle project: the active work item and gate verdict above the prompt, a /lens pane of work items and runs, and the next spec-cycle command suggested (never submitted).

band.title: Band
band.description: Draw the one-line band above the prompt.

suggest.title: Suggest next command
suggest.description: Propose the next spec-cycle command in the prompt box (Tab to take). Never submits.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Glyph set for the band and the pane.

snapshotPath.title: Snapshot path
snapshotPath.description: Where spec-cycle writes status.json, relative to the project; config.yaml is expected beside it.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Announce a verdict change (READY, NEEDS_HUMAN, BLOCKED_AT_LIMIT, done) once, as a toast.

openInEditor.title: Open in editor
openInEditor.description: How `o` on a document opens it: off copies the path only; auto tries a windowed $VISUAL/$EDITOR, then code/cursor by TERM_PROGRAM, then open (macOS); tmux-nvim opens nvim in a new tmux window. Anything but off runs a process on the host.

specCycleScript.title: spec-cycle script
specCycleScript.description: Absolute path of spec-cycle.mjs. When set, /lens refresh runs `node <script> status --json --write` in the project; empty keeps refresh read-only.
